column1: # A brain's finished files: their names in the data folder (brains/sub-<ID>/outputs) and where a run of this repository writes them.
# code/shared/linc-results links each one the run made itself into outputs/brains/sub-<ID>/outputs/ under its data-folder name.
#   name      the name in the data folder's brains/sub-<ID>/outputs/ (settings/files.tsv); <ID> is the brain
#   run_file  where a run writes it, with $LINC_DATA, $LINC_REBUILD_DATA, $LINC_MRI_DATA or $LINC_WORK and <ID>; several are separated
#             by " | " and tried in order: the first that is the run's own file wins: a file whose real path is inside the real path of
#             the root it was found under (a link to the paper's file, or a file inside a linked folder, is not)
#   made_by   the step of steps.yaml, or the command, that writes it
